name: block-curl-pipe-sh
description: Best-effort guard: refuses a download (curl, wget, iwr; ssh host cmd, scp/rsync/aws s3 cp to stdout) wired into a shell or interpreter (sh..fish, python, perl, ruby, node, php, lua, pwsh, deno, bun, su, source, eval, iex) by pipe, substitution or here-string, also inside bash -c/ssh/docker exec bodies, or downloaded then run with no checksum or signature step. nc/socat/one-liner reads ask. Misses: aliases, functions, outside variables, encoded text, renamed downloads. Friction only. [Best-effort in Devin by a PreToolUse hook shipped with the plugin's hooks.json (witnessed blocking on Devin CLI 3000.11.3 (local session), Windows, 2026-10-08). In the vendor's own words, plugin hooks are 'currently best effort and fail open -- if a hook fails to load or run, the session continues without it -- so don't rely on them for crucial guardrails yet', documented for local Devin sessions (the CLI and Devin Desktop) only. The hook command expands $DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT, an environment variable the vendor documents hook commands receive; whether that expansion happens inside a hooks.json command string is documented, not witnessed here. The hook needs git and a Python 3.11+ on PATH. Repo-wide git-hook and CI coverage still needs `chock sync`.]
